summary: Read a grid of characters. The character 1 means land and the character 0 means water. Land cells that share an edge, whether up, down, left, or right, belong to one piece. Touching only at a corner does not join them. Treat the outside past every border as water. Write how many separate land pieces the grid holds. A grid that is entirely water yields 0. One land cell alone is one piece. A piece may have any shape, and edge-connected cells stay one piece.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
